title: Helldivers 2 Reveals Full Warhammer 40K Warbond Arsenal Ahead of August Launch
excerpt: The Castellan's Creed Legendary Warbond brings Astra Militarum-inspired weapons, armor, and gear to Arrowhead's co-op shooter on August 12 across PS5, PC, and Xbox.
body:
• Helldivers 2's Castellan's Creed Legendary Warbond, a Warhammer 40,000 crossover, launches August 12, 2026 on PS5, PC, and Xbox at an expected price of 1,500 Super Credits.
  • The Warbond includes 16 items spanning weapons, armor, cosmetics, and vehicle patterns, all themed around Warhammer 40K's Astra Militarum faction rather than Space Marines.
  • Standout additions include the R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle, the iconic P/40-K Bolt Pistol, a 40-K Meltagun stratagem, and a new True Grit armor passive boosting weapon handling and reload speed.
  • This marks Helldivers 2's third major IP crossover following collaborations with Sony's Killzone and Microsoft's Halo: ODST franchises.

Arrowhead Game Studios has pulled back the curtain on the complete item roster for the Helldivers 2 x Warhammer 40,000 Legendary Warbond, dubbed Castellan's Creed. The collaboration, officially revealed on July 30, brings Games Workshop's grim-dark universe to Super Earth when it launches on August 12, 2026, across PlayStation 5, PC, and Xbox.

The reveal follows an announcement first made during the Warhammer Skulls showcase earlier this year, where Helldivers 2 game director Mikael Eriksson confirmed the partnership.

"At Arrowhead, we believe these two worlds fit perfectly together, and as a studio of diehard Warhammer fans, we are beyond thrilled to see this Legendary Warbond come to life."

— Mikael Eriksson, Game Director, Arrowhead Game Studios

What's in the Castellan's Creed Warbond

The Legendary Warbond packs 16 items across weapons, armor, cosmetics, and vehicle customization. On the offensive front, players get the R/40-K Hot-Shot Marksman Rifle as a primary weapon — described as deadly at both close and long range with a focus on precision shots. The P/40-K Bolt Pistol, one of the most recognizable sidearms in the Warhammer universe, arrives as a secondary weapon with what GameRant describes as "immense stopping power and versatility."

https://youtube.com/watch?v=Fgn4sk4IIXo https://x.com/HelldiversAlert/status/2082800816184783253

The support weapon slot gets the 40-K Meltagun, a stratagem that fires a short-ranged, superheated beam of thermal energy — a faithful adaptation of one of Warhammer 40K's signature anti-armor weapons. Rounding out the offensive gear is the G/40-K Meltamine, a proximity mine throwable that detonates when anyone — friend or foe — gets too close.

Two armor sets anchor the defensive lineup: the TG-122 Demo-Trooper heavy armor and the TG-8 Sharpshooter medium armor. Both come with the exclusive True Grit armor passive, which increases weapon handling by 20 points and boosts support weapon reload speed by 30 percent. Cosmetic items include two capes (Camo Cloak and City Fighter's Resolve), matching player banners, a "Still Standing" player title, and four Castellan's Green vehicle patterns covering the FRV, Exo Suit, Shuttle, and Hellpod.

Astra Militarum, Not Space Marines

Sharp-eyed fans will notice the Warbond draws from Warhammer 40K's Astra Militarum — the Imperium's regular human soldiers — rather than the franchise's marquee Space Marines. This was a deliberate creative choice signaled well before the reveal. Former Arrowhead CEO and current creative director Johan Pilestedt had previously indicated on social media that crossover content should maintain a "1:1 match" between IPs, keeping immersion intact.

The logic tracks. Helldivers are elite but expendable soldiers dying by the millions in the Second Galactic War, much like the Astra Militarum's rank-and-file troops who serve as the Imperium's first line of defense against alien threats. Genetically modified super-soldiers like Space Marines would break the tonal symmetry that makes the crossover work, according to GameSpot's analysis of the collaboration.

That said, the weaponry borrows from across the 40K arsenal. Bolt pistols and meltaguns are mainstays of multiple Warhammer factions, giving the Warbond enough firepower to satisfy fans without straying from the Helldivers identity.

A Growing Roster of Crossovers

Castellan's Creed is the third Legendary Warbond crossover in Helldivers 2's history. The Halo: ODST collaboration brought Microsoft's franchise into the fold, while the Killzone Legendary Warbond — initially offered as limited Superstore items — was eventually converted into a permanent Warbond following community demand in December 2025. Both previous Legendary Warbonds were priced at 1,500 Super Credits, and the Warhammer 40K pack is expected to follow suit.

The crossover arrives during a period of active course correction for Arrowhead. The studio has been rolling out quality-of-life improvements including support for multiple upscaling technologies, the introduction of Galactic Campaigns, and armor penetration rebalancing — all aimed at rebuilding goodwill after a stretch of negative Steam user reviews earlier this year.

What's Next

The Castellan's Creed Legendary Warbond goes live on August 12. As with previous Warbonds, exact release timing has not been confirmed, though players can expect it to follow the pattern of prior launches. The Warbond will be available permanently once released, so there is no limited-time pressure to purchase.

For the growing number of Indian gamers on PS5 and PC — and the Warhammer 40K tabletop community that has been steadily expanding in cities like Bengaluru, Mumbai, and Delhi — the crossover represents a convergence of two fan-favorite universes now accessible in a single package.
